mentions.name: TableForge
mentions.description: A browser-based, solo or multiplayer D&D 5e game where the Dungeon Master is an agentic AI with access to tools strictly following 5e rules. The DM handles narration and reacts to players through deterministic 5e-based tools (dice rolls, damage, sheet updates, memory), while character sheets, inventory, and spells are real server resources players manage. Sessions can be played in real time or asynchronously, and the DM can flesh out a full campaign story arc from a provided or library-selected premise, generating a fresh story that reacts to actual player decisions.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on TableForge[0], it's a browser based, solo or multiplayer, D&D 5e game. In TableForge, the DM is agentic with access to tools strictly following 5e rules.
